profile.headline: Software Engineer at BAE Systems OneArc
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and Game Developer currently based In NYC

5+ years of experience in real-time simulation and graphics, specializing in C++ SDK
development, systems integration, and delivering SDK training to engineering teams

Outside of work, I'm passionate about flight simulators, eSports, baseball, and model building

positions.title: Mid Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, NY, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Blue IG Team
• Develop/Update internal tools and customer facing features for Blue IG
• Visit customer sites to optimize Blue IG performance and answer questions
• Lead SDK training courses, teaching trainees how to use SDK products to suit their development needs

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SDK Team
• Develop, maintain, and update APIs across multiple products (VBS Sim SDK, Blue IG SDK)
• Create and improve internal development and testing tools
• Integrate external client software and hardware with our SDK products
• Support demo development in order to showcase various product features at industry conferences
• Answer questions and assist customers during SDK training courses

positions.title: Data Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
• Implemented and improved multiple data monitoring tools to automatically detect irregular data sets
• Utilized PostgreSQL databases and Apache Spark to read and filter data
• Created a checkpointing system which utilizes S3 buckets to maximize program efficiency

positions.title: CORE Studio Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an augmented reality Android app using Unity to help engineers visualize structural plans.
• Designed a new user interface to improve app organization and usability.
• Implemented Amazon Rekognition API to dynamically label photos for better organization.
